target_customer: Large pharmaceutical companies designing clinical trials
problem: Designing clinical trials requires scientists to spend months assembling evidence from prior trial research into usable datasets.
business_model: B2B enterprise data and AI agent services for pharma
product_category: AI agents for clinical trial design and quantitative evidence

founders.name: Emily Nieves
education: MIT, PhD candidate in Biological Engineering
founders.background_notes: Applied AI to modeling and simulation for drug development per YC page.

founders.name: Jawad Iqbal
education: Master's thesis in Robotics and AI
founders.background_notes: Two research publications per YC page.

competitors.name: Unlearn
competitors.what: Digital twins of trial participants to shrink control arms
competitors.traction_then: EMA positive draft opinion cited; founded 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting structured datasets from heterogeneous clinical trial literature with LLM agents is standard engineering with domain hard parts and pharma validation needs.

defensibility.rationale: Curated drug class datasets built for large pharma customers and the founders' pharma modeling background could be hard to replicate, but this is unproven.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ConcertAI launched an agentic accelerated clinical trials offering in February 2026 per press; no acquisition of Delineate found.

market_need_then: Trial design delay is costly (the company claims one day saved is worth $1 to 5M); the company reports work with two large pharma customers, self reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Formal: 'Quantitative evidence for consequential decisions' (company site)

brand_strength.rationale: A real word that suits precise evidence work, but other Delineate entities exist (a UK pharmacology company, a trademark filing by Delineate Inc.) and no press or community evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Delineate, a Winter 2025 company with a pharma modeling CEO and a robotics CTO, sells agent built evidence datasets to large pharma and reports two big customers plus a team of 20 on YC, but no priced rounds or press confirm that traction. It is active with no exit, and the main risk is that larger clinical data vendors add agentic trial design, so the evidence supports only a cautious early stage view.
notes: A listing reports $500K pre-seed (single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round). Another listing mentions an NIH STTR grant with MIT (single source, unverified). Founded year 2024 is from a GEO tracker; YC lists the batch as Winter 2025. Unlearn is the only competitor found with a source dated before the batch; it was founded in 2017 and its source is from 2022, so traction_then is older than the batch.
